sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, card C07297-K1 belonging to customer C07297 was utilized for an unauthorized online purchase of $482.12 under transaction reference 3476682. The cardholder contacted the bank disputing the transaction and confirmed they remained in possession of the physical card. The transaction originated from an unrecognized online device connection. The unauthorized authorization is consistent with card-not-present fraud resulting from card credential compromise. Total exposure is $482.12. The card has been blocked and submitted for reissue, and related account monitoring initiated.

stop_reason: Customer denial settled the verdict; card blocked and exposure contained.
